name: Chaos Fanatic

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: He throws unstable magic that can hit anyone standing near his target as well, and periodically detonates in a burst that drains your stats.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Magic and do not clump. The burst is what actually threatens you, and it ignores the prayer.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED, AND THE THINNEST FILE IN THIS WAVE. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc id CHAOS_FANATIC 6619. ONE MECHANIC IS NOT A JUDGEMENT THAT THIS BOSS HAS ONE MOVE. IT IS THE LIMIT OF WHAT THE CACHE WILL HONESTLY SUPPORT. The gamevals name no animation, no spotanim and no projectile for this boss at all: a search across all three spaces for 'fanatic' returns nothing. His standing animation is 2770, which the gamevals name DRUNK_PLAYER_READY, so even his idle is borrowed, and struct 3562, the Combat Achievements screen's own entry for him, falls back to animation 808, the plain human idle. There is therefore no attack animation to curate, no projectile to curate, and nothing to distinguish his ordinary magic attack from his disarming special. Rather than split them into two mechanics that would both have to detect on the same npc-spawn and so unlock simultaneously and meaninglessly, they are described together in one. The single npc-spawn trigger means this unlocks when you arrive rather than when he does anything, which is honest about what is known and is exactly what the live pass exists to fix. Because the trigger is a bare npc-spawn on the boss itself there is no false-positive risk here at all; the only cost is that the mechanic is uninformative until someone logs his real trigger ids. staticFallback is false; whether the borrowed idle reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Chaos Fanatic', matching 'name'. PREVIEW PASS 2026-08-07: The npc is an equipment-style assembly whose models[0] is its HEAD, and a widget MODEL renders exactly one cache model id, which is why it previewed as a floating head. Fixed the way docs/DECISIONS.md D36 and general-graardor.json already had it: pin the Combat Achievements screen's own pre-merged whole-body model rather than the npc. CA struct 3562 gives model 42732. Zoom and shiftY refitted on the merged model across animation 2770. BATCH 4 2026-08-07: Renamed to Standard Attacks and the description now carries the stat-draining burst Andrew asked to see. IT IS NOT A SEPARATE ROW: the cache gives npc 6619 one attack sequence, so a Magic Burst row would fire on the same trigger as this one. Same reasoning as obor.json. If a live trigger log turns up a distinct id for the burst it earns its own row.
